description: Use this only for general questions about what Fonciq offers or whether a capability exists. Not for a specific lot: for that lot’s plan choices call plan_get without plan. Returns what the connector offers now, what is coming soon and what is not offered, worded like fonciq.ca. Needs no account; answer only from the result. À utiliser uniquement pour une question générale sur ce que Fonciq offre ; pour les plans d’un lot précis, appelez plan_get sans plan. Sans compte.
name: capabilities
title: What Fonciq can do / Ce que Fonciq peut faire
